    {"type": "label", "x": 9, "y": 9, "text": "eye"}

  "do": "continue",
  "notes": "Plan: fish. Stroke 1 = top edge from nose (START) to tail joint. Stroke 2 = bottom edge branching from the nose, back to tail joint. Stroke 3 = tail fin branching off the tail joint. Eye label at upper body. Need someone on stroke 1 first; the rest grows from it."
